correctness.rationale: The combinatorial Alexander dual X contains exactly vertex, pair, connected induced triple P3, and induced four-cycle four-faces: the no-disconnected-triple criterion plus Mantel bound excludes five-faces in triangle-free 4-regular grid. In min(m,n)≥5 reflected quotient, local radius≤4 lattice lifts ensure precisely mn squares, 6mn triangles and complete pair graph. Free-pair collapses N square-tetrahedron/corner-triangle, N square-diagonal/triangle, 2N straight-distance-two-edge/triangle leave a triangulated Klein bottle plus h=binom N2−6N long 1-cells. The result is K∨∨^hS1; UCT H^1=Z^{h+1}, H^2=Z/2 and combinatorial Alexander duality give claimed degrees. Independently reconstructed exact dual f-vectors and each free pair for m,n=(5,5),(5,6),(6,6), finding h=150,255,414 and final surface χ=0, edges all in two triangles. Finite checks are not universal proof.
